title: Windows login fixed — WebAuthn now works on all platforms
summary: Sign-in no longer fails on Windows when using a passkey or security key.
body: A mismatch between the client's `userVerification: "preferred"` setting and the server's stricter verification requirement caused Windows logins to fail silently while macOS, iOS, and Android worked fine. The client now requests `required`, matching what the server enforces. If you or a colleague hit a blank login error on Windows, this is the fix.

title: Self-hosted edition now enforces the 30-CISO / 10-industry caps in code
summary: The free self-hosted build now enforces its panel-size and industry limits at runtime, not just in documentation.
body: Previously the OSS build inherited the cloud tier's 30–200 CISO range and unlimited industries — the pricing-page promise was narrated but not enforced. The caps (max 30 CISOs, max 10 industries) are now applied in code for self-hosted instances. Cloud and licensed builds are unaffected.
why: Drafted from a recent product change.

title: New mandate axis: how your panel's CISOs are organised shapes their advice
summary: A fourth CISO disposition axis — organisational authority and program maturity — is now live in the panel.
body: Príncipe's synthetic CISOs now vary across four axes: risk posture, time horizon, regional grounding, and — new — mandate maturity (reactive bolt-on → embedded → strategic). The distribution (~40/38/22) was derived from the CISO-Assembly gap analysis and is calibration-neutral against the existing benchmark set. Questions about budget authority, program scope, and organisational influence will reflect this dimension more accurately.
